name: Cyril Di Grandi
title: Co-founder and CEO
rationale: As the co-founder and CEO of Avicenna.AI, Di Grandi oversees the company's development of AI solutions for stroke assessment and other critical conditions. The company's recent FDA clearances suggest expertise in navigating the regulatory process, making him a valuable contact in the current regulatory landscape.

name: Suchi Saria
title: CEO
rationale: Bayesian Health is developing AI for clinical deterioration prediction and likely faces complex regulatory pathways due to their use of patient data and predictive algorithms. The company would have to navigate the FDA's evolving approach to AI/ML in healthcare in an environment affected by recent regulatory staffing changes.

name: Alexander Sardiña
title: CEO
rationale: Whiterabbit emerged from stealth with FDA clearance for WRDensity but has additional AI products in development that will require FDA review. As a radiologist who became CEO, Sardiña would have valuable insights into the current regulatory landscape.

name: Brandon Suh
title: CEO
rationale: Lunit has secured FDA clearances for their AI imaging products but may be working on additional clearances in a regulatory environment affected by recent FDA staffing changes and layoffs in the AI review division. Their experience with multiple clearance processes makes them a valuable resource.

name: Stéphane Berger
title: Regulatory and Quality Manager
rationale: Avicenna.AI successfully secured multiple FDA clearances in March 2024 after a lengthy regulatory process, with Berger playing a key role in navigating the complex CADx approval process for their CINA-ASPECTS product. The successful clearance after dealing with regulatory challenges makes them valuable for insights into recent FDA processes.
